title: TrainerRoad FTP Progression Stall After Build Block
app: COROS, Wahoo ELEMNT, TrainerRoad, Apple Fitness / HealthKit exports, Concept2 Logbook, Strava, Garmin Connect, and Zwift activity feeds via official APIs, FIT/CSV exports, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=trainerroad:workout
| bin _time span=8w
| stats max(ftp_estimate_w) as ftp_estimate_w, count(eval(status="completed")) as completed_sessions by athlete _time
| streamstats current=f last(ftp_estimate_w) as previous_ftp by athlete
| where completed_sessions>=10 AND previous_ftp>0 AND ftp_estimate_w<=previous_ftp
| sort - _time
description: Uses TrainerRoad workout history telemetry to monitor FTP movement after solid blocks of completed training in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for plateaus that deserve a plan change or recovery week, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest TrainerRoad workout history data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a weekly cadence.
visualization: Eight-week trend of completed sessions and estimated FTP.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates FTP movement after solid blocks of completed training so you can spot plateaus that deserve a plan change or recovery week before it becomes annoying.
